status: two reference sheets saved, user reference review and actual model fit pending
purpose: Eight reusable meshes for a Rose Keep entrance, stair, terrace and turret assembly test; not a complete keep.

source.authority: Visible silhouette, materials and ornament vocabulary only. Dimensions, rear faces and join construction below are proposals. Small source cannot resolve exact carvings.
source.reference_policy: Use this single source at a time. Region boxes are lookup aids in original pixels, not new generated images or precise object masks.

preservation.note: Do not replace the world anchor, reservation or pad. Legacy 360 m building height is not a surveyed height or a multiplier for doors, steps and people. The first assembly tests a local bay, not the full tower silhouette.

reference_budget.policy: Two existing reserved sheets now saved: four structural sections and twelve local fittings. The eight priority mesh targets remain a subset of these sixteen references. No extra reservations or approved final models.

export_contract.preferred_format: GLB; optional editable BLEND alongside it
export_contract.axes: Exported GLB: X right, Y up, front -Z. Blender: Z up; use normal glTF axis conversion. All coordinates below describe exported GLB.
export_contract.dimensions_order: width X, depth Z, height Y; bounding-box sizes, not positions
export_contract.origin: Declared assembly datum per asset; never automatically recenter after setting the pivot.
export_contract.filename_policy: Preserve the exact asset ID and v001 filename below. Separate mesh objects may share a GLB, but IDs and pivots must survive. Supply one asset GLB per list row for easiest import.
export_contract.textures: Reuse materials; 2K PBR atlas is a starting limit, not an achieved device budget. No baked scenery, lettering, large shadows or plants in structural textures.
export_contract.collision: Provide simple separate UCX_<asset_id>_<number> hulls or let the runtime make substrate collision. Never one convex hull across a doorway, hollow turret or stair route. Tiny ornaments do not each need a collider.
export_contract.generation_readiness: Labelled construction reference sheets saved; user image approval and exact mesh/Function checks remain pending. No paid model generation authorised.

assets.name: Rose keep wall return / entrance host
assets.origin: Main wall midpoint at walking floor: [0,0,0]. Main wall X=-4..4, Z=0..0.6; right return X=3.4..4, Z=0..4; Y=0..6.
assets.construction: Blush masonry with pale trim, one real pointed-arch doorway, plus a short right-hand return. This orthogonal test return is inferred; angled and cliff-conforming variants follow the source audit. Keep all ornament detachable.
assets.source_region_note: Lower portal and adjacent pink wall; rear and return depth are not visible measurements.
reject_if: Door is a painted recess or blocked by a single collision hull
Wrong opening profile or narrower than 2.4 m
Palace-scale door, fused roses or a complete building instead of one host

assets.name: Stair flight with turn landing
assets.origin: Lower approach at first riser [0,0,0]. Ascend -Z. Flight ends Z=-3; landing continues to Z=-5.8. Lowest underside Y=-0.25, top walking floor Y=1.5.
assets.construction: Ten planar steps, each 0.15 m rise and 0.30 m going, then a 2.8 m square landing. Source pale stone and low rounded return vocabulary; guards separate. Clear width 2.4 m after edge guards. This reuses K09 dimensions, not its final palace ornament.
assets.source_region_note: Winding exterior stairs and landing. Exact number and height of steps are proposed, not counted from this thumbnail.
reject_if: Melted, sloped or uneven treads
Rail blocks either selected landing exit
Step rises exceed 0.20 m or clear width falls below 2.4 m

assets.name: Cliff terrace bay
assets.origin: Centre of top walking surface [0,0,0]; X=-4..4, Z=-3..3; all substrate below Y=0, bottom Y=-1.5.
assets.construction: Level stone deck with pale edge cornice and downward cliff-facing fascia, no surrounding garden scene. Simple joining ends. A separate rock/support host must meet its underside; the fascia is not an unsupported 8 m cantilever design. Keep a 2.4 m clear entry corridor.
assets.source_region_note: Raised entrance terrace and stone edge over the rock shoulder. Deck depth and hidden supports need engineering views.
reject_if: Walking top is buckled or a painted garden is fused to it
Fascia blocks the stair socket
Decor projects across the 2.4 m route

assets.name: Round turret / window band
assets.origin: Centre of lower ring [0,0,0]; bottom Y=0, upper ring Y=12; external radius 6 m, wall thickness 0.6 m.
assets.construction: Hollow cylindrical blush-stone band with four identical arched openings at cardinal directions, 1.8 m wide, 6 m apex height, sill 1.2 m above band base. Front source window vocabulary; fourfold repetition and hidden back are proposed for the first fit test. Open ring ends; no cone roof, glazing, floor, vines or unrelated tower attached.
assets.source_region_note: Left round turret body. This 12 m test band is not a recovered diameter or the whole tall turret.
reject_if: Flattened or distorted cylinder
Windows do not cut through the shell
Interior filled or top and bottom ring sizes differ

assets.name: Rose keep window insert
assets.origin: Bottom centre of insert [0,0,0], outward -Z. Match S01's 4.8 m spring / 6 m apex profile with 0.01 m edge clearance; register as a sill-relative insert, not an independent wall.
assets.construction: Separate frame, simple subtle glazing and restrained trim. Pale stone, muted gold and quiet glass from Rose Keep, not giant blue-and-pink palace star panes. Back face and thickness visible. Opening cut in S01 remains behind the insert.
assets.source_region_note: Upper left turret windows; fine tracery cannot be recovered exactly at this resolution.
reject_if: Opaque painted masonry replaces the glazing
Frame changes the host arch profile
Entire turret included

assets.name: Castle parapet repeat
assets.origin: Centre of lower mounting edge [0,0,0]; repeat X=-0.5..0.5, depth Z=-0.06..0.06, top Y=1.1.
assets.construction: One restrained stone guard repeat; planar end profiles, separate simple continuous barrier collider. Preserve Rose Keep terrace-edge vocabulary. A 1.1 m test guard height is proposed for drops, not an assertion that every low garden edge in the source is a guard. Use short infill at ends; do not stretch decorated repeats. Slope and corner return D08/D06 remain a later matching pass.
assets.source_region_note: Stone terrace edge around stair return; exact baluster detail is unresolved.
reject_if: Repeat ends differ
Visible geometry is treated as verified collision
Guard crosses an entrance or is scaled to absorb remainder

assets.name: Burgundy cone roof strip / quadrant
assets.origin: Centre of cone's base circle [0,0,0]. One 90-degree sector occupies X=0..6.2, Z=0..6.2; base Y=0, tip Y=12. Pivot lies at a bounding-box corner by design.
assets.construction: One hollow conical quarter-shell with burgundy shingle pattern, 0.12 m nominal shell thickness and matching radial seam edges. Four copies rotated by 90 degrees give a 12.4 m diameter cap over S01's 12 m diameter, with 0.2 m overhang per side. Conical roof, not an onion dome. Finial and eave cornice are separate later fittings.
assets.source_region_note: Left tower conical shingle roof. The quadrant split and underside construction are inferred.
reject_if: Purple onion dome substituted
Radial joins fail to close after four rotations
Base diameter mismatches the 12.4 m cap or a solid cone fills the interior

assets.name: Keep arch surround
assets.origin: Threshold centre [0,0,0], flat mounting back at Z=0, trim projects to Z=-0.2. Fits S02 opening at X=-0.5, Y=0.
assets.construction: Pale stone arch band with restrained rose-compatible carving. Inner void must match S02: 2.4 m clear, 3.2 m spring, 3.8 m apex. Outer height 4.3 m includes trim above apex. No masonry filling, gate leaf or complete wall attached.
assets.source_region_note: Lower pointed entrance surround; detailed carving is unresolved and must be conservatively inferred.
reject_if: Trim narrows or blocks the aperture
Flat back is missing
Heavy palace ornament replaces the source's restrained stone portal

assembly_proposal.coordinate_space: Local fit test, not world placement or a surveyed reconstruction
assembly_proposal.turret_roof: Four D01 copies at [16,12,-9], yaw 0/90/180/270 degrees. D03 inserts use S01's four actual window attachment frames, not just cardinal point positions.
assembly_proposal.walk_test: Lower approach -> ten stairs -> landing -> terrace -> true doorway -> supported court stub -> reverse. Court stub, cliff support, side guards and stair guard returns must be supplied by the Function prototype; these eight meshes alone do not complete a safe playable route.
assembly_proposal.must_not_claim: No assembled geometry, browser traversal, guard collision, terrain support, approved images or accepted final models are delivered by a list.
